caption: The drawing depicts a puppet or doll figure positioned centrally against a plain beige background. The figure has dark brown skin, gray curly hair, and exaggerated facial features including large white eyes, a broad nose, and a wide, red-lipped mouth with visible white teeth. The figure wears a loose, long-sleeved shirt with vertical blue and purple stripes, and a red bow or ribbon at the collar. Underneath, there is a tanish-brown undershirt with horizontal stripes. The figure has purple quilted or textured trousers and gray or beige knee-length socks with horizontal stripes. The black shoes have decorative rosettes or buckles, and the figure wears a dark cape or cloak that drapes down behind it. The puppet's left arm is bent outward, and the right arm is at its side. The artist's signature, "Dorothy Chichester," appears at the bottom right corner.
title: Minstrel Hand Puppet
